OverviewThe NZXT C1500 Platinum PSU offers highly efficient, digitally-controlled power, ATX 3.1 compliance, and PCIe 5.1 connectivity with a high-performance magnetic levitation fan.
Designed with ATX 3.1 and PCIe 5.1 compliance to power current and future generations of high-performance GPUs and CPUs.
Includes two 16-pin 12V-2x6 PCIe 5.1 cables, each capable of delivering over 600 watts to NVIDIA® GeForce RTX™ RTX 50 Series graphics cards.
Digital power enables precise voltage regulation, resulting in higher efficiency and lower ripple noise.
Exceeding 80 Plus Platinum standards, the 94% efficiency reduces power consumption for lower monthly bills and cooler, quieter operation.
Certified for ultra-high efficiency and ultra-low noise with Cybenetics Titanium efficiency and Cybenetics A- noise level ratings.
140 mm magnetic levitation fan uses air-suspended blades for low noise, high airflow, and a long lifespan.
Constructed using high-quality 105°C Japanese capacitors for excellent reliability and long-lasting performance.
Fully modular design simplifies cable management, allowing for the connection of only necessary cables.
Compact 180 mm form factor optimizes valuable case space while promoting improved airflow.
Future-Proof PowerATX 3.1 and PCIe 5.1 compliance supports current and future high-performance GPUs and CPUs.

Frequently Asked Questions
Does the C1500 Platinum support 12V-2x6 graphics cards?
Yes. The C1500 Platinum includes two 16-pin (12+4) 12V-2x6 PCIe cables and six 6+2-pin PCIe cables, each 650 mm long. The C1500 Platinum is an ATX 3.1 power supply, compliant with ATX12V v3.1 and EPS12V v2.92.
Does the C1500 Platinum deliver the full 1500 W on a 110 V outlet?
The C1500 Platinum delivers its full 1500 W on 115–240 Vac input. On 100–115 Vac circuits, total output is rated at 1300 W, so check your outlet voltage when planning a build near the top of the C1500 Platinum's range.
How efficient is the C1500 Platinum?
The C1500 Platinum is rated 80 PLUS Platinum. At 115 V, efficiency measures 92% at 10% load, 94% at 20% load, 93.8% at 50% load and 90.8% at full load.
Is the C1500 Platinum fully modular, and what cables are included?
Yes, the C1500 Platinum is fully modular. The box includes a 600 mm 24-pin ATX cable, 700 mm 4+4-pin and 8-pin CPU cables, three SATA cables with 12 SATA connectors in total, a peripherals cable with 4 connectors and an AC power cord.
How big is the C1500 Platinum, and what warranty does it have?
The C1500 Platinum measures 150 x 86 x 180 mm (W x H x D) and is cooled by a 140 mm fan with a magnetic levitation bearing. Its zero fan mode keeps the fan off until system load reaches 60%. NZXT covers the C1500 Platinum with a 10-year warranty.
